remarks: BUILD THE LUXURY HOME YOU'VE ALWAYS ENVISIONED on this exceptional VACANT LOT located on Windermere Drive South! Enjoy convenient access to Edmonton International Airport, approximately 20 minutes away, along with HOA access to the pool and additional amenities at the Windermere Leisure Centre. A rare and outstanding opportunity to design and build a custom residence that reflects the luxury, sophistication, and elevated lifestyle you have always envisioned. (id:67522)
